digest.component_or_area: CI lint enforcement for canonical store write paths
propositions: Production bugs (3435, 3a33, 4dd2, 4c6c class) resulted from store write paths that bypassed canonical write seams with raw git commands, including bare 'git add/commit/rm' in GitHub workflow YAML and shell scripts without proper transaction wrapping.

Deterministic two-layer CI lint must flag raw git mutation verbs in Python (AST-based, module-agnostic) and in workflows/shell (cwd-aware within-step tracker context detection) while allowing inline '# raw-git-ok: <reason>' markers without reason-requirement exemption.

Authorized write seams are: (1) store seam internals in gitutil.run_git/run_git_write, event_append._run_git, txn.py, and purge_bridge.py with locked transactions; and (2) reconciler seam via git_adapter.py and _ref_lock.py; all other raw git mutations are either bypass violations or disposable-sandbox writes.

Lint must detect both literal-argv raw subprocess invocations (subprocess.run with git mutation verb) and calls to shared git wrappers (run_git, run_git_write, _run_git) with mutation arguments via intra-function variable tracking, resolving local list literals and splat-expanded variables while fail-closed on opaque forwarded argv.

Report-mode bootstrap must inventory all hits before enforcement; every hit is remediated or marked with mandatory reason reason in the same change, with authoritative disposition replacing prose enumeration.
First-scan clean tree and teaching message must direct authors to sanctioned event-append/transaction/reconciler APIs rather than raw git invocation.
